title: Worst-case Subset Sum below the half exponent
exact_target: Is there one uniform bounded-error classical logarithmic-word RAM algorithm for positive-integer Subset Sum which, for every fixed c, uses at most $C_c$ $2^{0.49n}$ operations on every random path whenever its n items have bit length $b\leq n^c$, and is correct with probability $\geq 2/3$ without being given c?
